legs.name: Whisperwood Crossroads
legs.description: Two ruts meet under a leaning mile-post. Crows watch from bare oaks. North the trees thicken; east the river road.

legs.name: Shallow Ford
legs.description: Cold water over smooth stones. Wagon tracks climb the far bank toward mill smoke on the horizon.

legs.name: Chalk Switchbacks
legs.description: The road climbs in tight turns. Loose stones skitter downhill. Wind smells of ore and pine.

legs.name: Ridge Overlook
legs.description: Havenbrook's lantern fountain is a pinprick south. North, mine smoke stains the sky.
